clips.title: The story
paras: South of the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus, furbolgs threaten travelers in Ban'ethil Hollow. The ravine also hides the entrance to Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

Furbolgs roam the rocky descent into Ban'ethil Hollow. Their strange affliction has driven them mad, and they stalk the nearby road, ambushing couriers and wandering sentinels. The hollow lies just south of the road between Dolanaar and Darnassus, a reminder that Teldrassil's woodland is not wholly safe. At the ravine's back stands the entrance to Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Slumbering druids and ancient tunnels lie within, threatened by the maddened beasts outside.
